annotations.title: Find a scene to be photographed in

description: Searches CMeIn's scene catalogue — over 4,500 settings, filtered to the ones that suit this account. Use it to recommend one: describe what the person is after and it finds the scenes that fit. Generating the photo itself is done in the app. Needs the "scenes:read" permission.
name: find_scene
